mapper.sql: select id, name, description, category, content::text as content, variables::text as variables, version, status, created_by, created_at, updated_at from ai_prompt_templates
mapper.select:
and name like concat('%', #{name}, '%')
and category like concat('%', #{category}, '%')
and status = #{status}
order by updated_at desc, created_at desc
mapper.update: update ai_prompt_templates set name = #{name}, description = #{description}, category = #{category}, content = CAST(#{content} AS jsonb), variables = CAST(#{variables} AS jsonb), status = #{status}, version = coalesce(version, 1) + 1, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}::uuid
